name: Vayu UI
summary: MIT React 19 + Tailwind v4 UI toolkit with 60+ accessible components, hooks, CLI, and MCP.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 60+ free Vayu UI components.
CLI copies source into project UI dir (default components/ui) — not an npm runtime package of components.
Requires React 19+ and Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens via `npx vayu-ui-cli init`.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
